items.title: Ingénieur-e Calcul Expérimenté-e Conception Aérocombustion Moteurs Civils F/H
items.excerpt: Safran Aircraft Engines is recruiting an experienced aero-combustion design engineer for next-generation civil and military combustors. The role explicitly calls for high-fidelity calculations and sits in the combustor and rear-body design office, providing a current signal of active combustor design and simulation work.
items.query: site:safran-group.com Safran Aircraft Engines September 2026 combustor turbine design simulation

items.title: Leader Technique Aérothermique – Turbine Haute Pression F/H
items.excerpt: Safran Aircraft Engines is hiring a high-pressure-turbine aerothermal technical lead for future military engines, explicitly including the T-REX evolution of the M88. The role covers aerothermal integration of turbine modules and interfaces with integration, assembly and development teams.
items.query: site:safran-group.com Safran Aircraft Engines September 2026 high pressure turbine T-REX M88

items.title: Leader technique mécanique integration Turbine Basse Pression LEAP F/H
items.excerpt: Safran Aircraft Engines is recruiting a mechanical integration technical lead in its post-development low-pressure-turbine design organization for LEAP. The posting covers study and mechanical integration responsibilities for a family of LPT parts, indicating continuing engineering work around in-service LEAP turbine modules.
items.query: site:safran-group.com Safran Aircraft Engines September 2026 LEAP low pressure turbine integration

items.title: Open Fan engine technology aims for epic efficiency. It also has major durability potential
items.excerpt: CFM describes its RISE Open Fan architecture as targeting about 20% better fuel efficiency than conventional turbofans and highlights durability work around the fan system, aerodynamics and adaptive-cycle capability, including reduced dust ingestion for hot and harsh environments. Performance figures remain vendor targets.
items.query: site:cfmaeroengines.com September 2026 CFM RISE Open Fan durability efficiency

items.title: A production boost, powered by hard data
items.excerpt: RTX describes a data and AI platform used at Pratt & Whitney AutoAir in Holt, Michigan, where fan-blade output increased 20% each year since 2024 and production time fell by roughly 20%. The article frames the site as part of a wider strategy connecting factory systems, data and digital tools across manufacturing.
items.query: site:rtx.com August September 2026 Pratt Whitney data AI manufacturing fan blade production

items.title: GKN Aerospace breaks ground on North Charlestown expansion as demand for engine components grows
items.category: 航空機・主要サプライヤー
items.excerpt: GKN Aerospace started construction on a $16 million North Charlestown expansion for critical aero-engine components. The project adds about 57,000 sq ft, bringing the site to nearly 97,000 sq ft, and is intended to broaden manufacturing activity and support future engine-component production growth.
items.query: site:gknaerospace.com September 2026 GKN Aerospace engine component manufacturing expansion

items.title: GKN Aerospace to advance key technologies for Sweden's future combat air systems under new FMV agreement
items.category: 航空機・主要サプライヤー
items.excerpt: FMV awarded GKN Aerospace an approximately SEK 390 million contract for concept studies, technology development and demonstrators through 2028 under Sweden's Future Combat Air System Concept Programme. GKN identifies thermal management, onboard electrical power and propulsion-related systems as strategic technology areas.
items.query: site:gknaerospace.com September 2026 Sweden future combat air systems propulsion thermal management

items.title: Swiss company Neural Concept Establishes Direct Presence in India to Accelerate AI-Native Engineering Across Automotive and Manufacturing
items.excerpt: Discovery candidate: Neural Concept opened teams in Bengaluru and Pune as manufacturers scale its physics-aware AI across design and simulation workflows. The company serves aerospace, defense, automotive, energy and other engineering sectors, making its expansion a useful signal for continued monitoring of production-grade engineering AI adoption.
items.query: site:neuralconcept.com September 2026 AI native engineering design simulation India

items.title: AVL and QinetiQ to Advance Land Mobility Development
items.excerpt: Discovery candidate: AVL and QinetiQ formed a strategic partnership around MBSE, digital twins, physics-based modelling, virtual validation and physical test for defence mobility programmes. The connected virtual-to-field validation stack makes AVL worth monitoring beyond automotive for digital engineering and defence development methods.
items.query: site:avl.com September 2026 QinetiQ digital engineering MBSE digital twin defence
